gaussian: Uniform mixture over DQN arrival latent coordinates; diagonal covariance (sigma_observed_sd_fraction * observed latent SD)^2
density: Bilinear interpolation of section 14 peak-normalized Gaussian-smoothed UMAP visit density, not a density percentile
expression: Full original VAE decoder output clamped at zero in log1p CP10K space; select 1994 ranked non-required + six required genes. Actual KO uses measured adata.X, not VAE reconstruction.
interpretation: Model-based sampled KO-like expression; not evidence of causal KO accuracy.
